# Bluegrass Digital Forge

> Handcrafted websites for Lake Cumberland, Kentucky businesses, built by a neighbor in Monticello, KY. Flat one-time pricing (Starter Sites $1,200, Business Suites from $2,500), full code ownership, no monthly lock-in. Serves Wayne, Pulaski, Russell and McCreary counties. Contact: contact@bluegrassdigitalforge.com
